documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Un-Audited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026 And Conduct Of Postal Ballot
Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving Inter-Alia The Un- Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Nitta Gelatin India Limited reported its FY 2025-26 performance, highlighting the successful commissioning of its new Collagen Peptide Project with an installed capacity of 3.5 metric tonnes per day. The company stated that its Gelatin Expansion Project is progressing as per schedule to further augment manufacturing capabilities. Management noted global trade headwinds arising from United States tariff measures and geopolitical conflicts, which it is addressing through market diversification and operational efficiencies. Additionally, the parent entity Nitta Gelatin Group announced a long-term management vision targeting double net sales by the fiscal year ending March 2033. Nitta Gelatin India Limited reported gross revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled a vision targeting double net sales and a 2.5-fold increase in operating income by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
guidance.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for the gelatin industry remains encouraging across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, and specialty applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the gelatin industry also remains encouraging, supported by growing demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and specialty applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The company held a ground-breaking ceremony for its Collagen Peptide expansion project in April 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: The Ground-Breaking ceremony (Bhumi Pooja) of your Company’s Collagen Peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024 at its factory located in Kakkanad, Kochi.

capex_expansion.claim: The Collagen Peptide expansion project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Ossein and Limed Ossein output from the Reva Division caters entirely to the requirements of NGI, Japan.
orders_capacity.quote: The Ossein/ Limed Ossein from Reva Division caters entirely to NGI, Japan’s requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: US tariff measures introduced heightened global trade uncertainties that affected international supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year was marked by heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment following tariff measures introduced by the United States, which impacted international supply chains and trade flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts and potential expansion of major economy tariff measures require continued operational caution.
risks_headwinds.quote: Notwithstanding the positive domestic outlook, uncertainties arising from geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, volatility in global trade flows and the potential continuation or expansion of tariff measures by major economies, including the United States, warrant continued caution.

management_commitments.claim: The Nitta Gelatin Group targets doubling net sales and multiplying operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
management_commitments.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

management_commitments.claim: The Collagen Peptide expansion project is expected to be commissioned.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
